runner_requirements.why: The lab modules decoded from CODE_B64 (Experiment/CLEANTUNE-01/run.py _find / _find_all, FACELORA-03/run.py adir, SCALE-CC-01/run.py vox2b_dir, T3ENC-01/run.py strict_drop, DSEL-02 / DSEL-03 table lookups) locate the faces of e65xbs, feats_vox2b, lid_strict.json and the fold tables by scanning the literal path /kaggle/input (env overrides exist only for some: CT_DIRS, FL3_DIRS). Code decoded at run time from a base64 zip is written to disk and imported; the runner's replacement of the string '/kaggle/input' in the stage code does not reach it. The literal path /kaggle/input must therefore show exactly this stage's inputs while the stage runs: e.g. a container with the virtual input mounted at /kaggle/input (as release/docker/ff.py does), or a symlink /kaggle/input -> the virtual input on a Linux host without /kaggle. In a Kaggle notebook whose own /kaggle/input holds other attachments, run this stage in a session with exactly its inputs attached (as the original run). /kaggle/input must also hold no second copy of these files: the notebook itself asserts one face_clipB3_train.npy folder, the modules take the first hit.
runner_requirements.kaggle: separate session with exactly these inputs

dev_data: E2E_SPLIT = 'eval' (code cell 01): the dev branch (R11 reference zip next to the saved models, the dev score zip of CLEANTUNE-01/run.py:635) is never taken; the dev zips that sit inside evalu-f0s-p / evalu-f1s-p are attached but not read (DESIGN 2.8).
